  # trace_filter

  Apply OR within each address list and AND between the lists; omitted/empty lists are unrestricted. Match CALL sender/recipient, CREATE creator/created address, SELFDESTRUCT destroyed account/refund beneficiary. Failed CREATE has no created-address match. Reward author matches toAddress and has no fromAddress. Sort by block, transaction, preorder, then rewards; paginate after matching. Capture one canonical snapshot for the request and error if required history is unavailable (H03-H06,H23,H27). This is a provisional trace profile; see docs-api/docs/trace-profile.md and its H01-H29 decision references.

  Returns localized traces matching an address filter.

  ## Parameters (by position)

  **Filter** `object` *required*

  Inclusive block range; defaults fromBlock earliest, toBlock latest, after 0, count unlimited subject to an explicit server limit. OR within each address list; AND between lists. Missing or empty lists are unrestricted; null is invalid. mode is outside this baseline. Resolve tags once per request. Apply filtering before pagination; count 0 returns \[]. Return an error rather than silently truncate when a server limit is exceeded (H03,H04,H23,H27).

      **Result** `array<object>`

      Preorder traversal. Retain root precompile calls regardless of value. Omit nested precompile frames with zero value; retain nested frames with nonzero transferred or inherited value, whether successful or failed. traceAddress gives child ordinals and subtraces counts direct children in the emitted tree, excluding omitted frames (H29). Omitting a call frame must not omit its caller VM return-memory effects. Standalone historical records require localization; only protocol rewards have null transaction fields. Frames inside simulation and replay envelopes omit localization and protocol rewards. Failed frames require error and result, retaining revert bytes and measured gas when available, otherwise result is null. Stable error-kind vocabulary is an open decision (H05,H09,H10,H24).

  <div>
    <details>
      <summary>
        Show Option 6 `Historical call trace record or protocol reward` array
      </summary>

      #### `Historical call trace record or protocol reward` fields

      Array result. Each item independently matches one of the following variants; different variants may occur in the same array.

      **Result** `array<object>`

      Preorder traversal. Retain root precompile calls regardless of value. Omit nested precompile frames with zero value; retain nested frames with nonzero transferred or inherited value, whether successful or failed. traceAddress gives child ordinals and subtraces counts direct children in the emitted tree, excluding omitted frames (H29). Omitting a call frame must not omit its caller VM return-memory effects. Standalone historical records require localization; only protocol rewards have null transaction fields. Frames inside simulation and replay envelopes omit localization and protocol rewards. Failed frames require error and result, retaining revert bytes and measured gas when available, otherwise result is null. Stable error-kind vocabulary is an open decision (H05,H09,H10,H24).

      ***
